title: Gahl-Mills, Baggetta look to empower others as co-directors of OLC
summary_en: The Paul H. O’Neill Center for Leadership in Public Service co-directors Karen Gahl-Mills and Matthew Baggetta discuss how leadership is learned through practice, coaching, and empowering others.
